setup.title: First run
setup.lead: Create the Platform administrator. You will be signed in right away and can continue the setup.
setup.codeHelp: The server prints the code at startup: find the setup_code_issued line in the crm-api log (docker compose logs crm-api). The code is valid for 24 hours.
setup.codeRequired: Enter the code from the server log
setup.name: First and last name
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, letters and digits, without the name from the email.
setup.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters
consequence: CRM gets an administrator with this email; the first-run code stops working.
You are signed in to the Platform with this account right away.
Next the wizard offers to create your company and connect the bot, ERP, mail and AI models.

setup.stateErrorText: CRM did not respond. Make sure the server is running and try again.
setup.doneText: The administrator exists. Sign in to the Platform with email and password.

errors.SETUP_CODE_INVALID: The code is wrong. Copy it from the server log as is.
errors.SETUP_CODE_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Open /setup again: the system issues a new code in the server log.
errors.SETUP_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.SETUP_DONE: The administrator already exists. Sign in to the Platform.
